Pressure transmitters for HTF service with a design pressure of 500 psig and temperature of 750 Deg. F.
Instrument type is Pressure Transmitter, measuring Absolute Pressure with an accuracy of ± 0.1% Of Calibrated Span.
Housing material is Aluminium, electrical connection is 1/2" NPT, and enclosure protection is NEMA 4.
Output signal is Resistance (4-20 mA + HART), power supply is 2-Wire / 24 VDC, and hazardous area classification is Class I, Division II.
Special environment conditions include solar radiation with a maximum of 1,008 W/m².
Manufacturer is ABB, transmitter model details are on sheet 7, and chem seal details are also on sheet 7.
The document contains specifications for pressure transmitters used in the TES Area of a solar power plant.
There are two sheets: one for HTF Pressure Transmitters and another for MS Pressure Transmitters.
All pressure transmitters have the same model number and chemical seal/flushing ring number.
The MS Pressure Transmitters have specific process conditions, sensor and body specifications, and transmitter details.
Notes provide important information about materials, environmental conditions, and vendor requirements.

Specifications for Nitrogen Service Pressure Transmitters including fluid, design pressure, and accuracy.
Revision history up to version 4 dated February 2012.
